title: Designing meaning and momentum: A value-integrated academic services framework for distance education
reason: Design-based mixed-methods study of a service framework in distance graduate education. LMS logs are used only for implementation-fidelity monitoring; ANOVA and SEM relate questionnaire constructs (service quality, engagement, wellbeing). No per-student LMS indicator related to outcomes.

extraction.country: Indonesia (Universitas Terbuka; ethics approval there; five centres)
extraction.lms_indicators: LMS activity logs for implementation fidelity only (aggregate)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported engagement (SEI), values integration, academic wellbeing, service quality
extraction.notes: SEM betas (e.g. 0.34, 0.42) are survey-construct paths; partial eta2/d are time x group effects. Neither is an LMS indicator relation.
